description: Land Title Settlement Department - Konwewa, Tambuththegama D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110073
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations for multiple land parcels in the Anuradhapura District. It contains detailed schedules of land parcels with their owners, extents, and title classifications, making it clearly a Land Gazette according to the classification criteria.
